name: Shoulder YTWL
instructions: Lie face-down on an incline bench or the floor with arms hanging.
Raise your arms into a Y shape, thumbs up, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Lower, then raise into a T shape out to the sides.
Lower, then bend elbows into a W, then straighten into an L. A rotator-cuff health series.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: A beginner bodyweight pull-pattern exercise for the rear delts. Shoulder YTWL strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
